name: Forger's Hideout
title: Forger's Hideout
summary: A mansion of four buildings (a 31 m clock tower and 7-, 4- and 3-storey wings, 18-31 m) on the flat 48 m summit of a 200 m obsidian spire at 76.0S 67.1W, reachable only through the KEEP OUT! portal by Bandit Castle (Counterfeit Writ quest); neighbouring spires of the Obsidian Plains stand 200 m to the south and south-east.

shots.standingOrder: Climb slowly round the clock-towered mansion on top of the 200 m obsidian spire, 75 to 95 m out, with the sun behind; nothing within 40 m of the lens.
shots.notes: Signature helix around the mansion on the 200 m obsidian spire: radius 75 -> 95 m, 30 -> 50 m above the summit (z 230-250), 0.09 turn from the south-south-west; the clock tower and the wings stand over the sheer needle with the obsidian plain and the neighbouring spires 200 m below, sun behind. Subject point = the clock tower. shots.standingOrder: Locked off on the plain south-west of the spire, zoom slowly from the whole obsidian needle to the mansion on its summit; no camera movement.
shots.notes: Locked-off zoom from 300 m south-west (camera hovering 76 m above the plain): fov 60 -> 16 deg, from the whole obsidian needle with its mansion crown to the three-storey wing and the clock tower behind it; front-lit by the afternoon sun. shots.standingOrder: Fly west-north-west past the spire-top mansion 70 m out and 30 m above the summit, letting it swing through the frame with the plain 200 m below; nothing within 40 m.
shots.notes: Fly-by 30 m above the summit and 70 m out, heading west-north-west at 8 m/s: the mansion swings through the frame against the sky while the plain lies 200 m below, the neighbouring obsidian spires sliding behind; sun behind-left.
